register_readings.wire_derivable: Exact object first-register reason; later-register repetition predicate expressly derives from first-register field presence under appendix2.

Current overlay uses optional for no-readings 214/218 in Z04/Z06F/Z10, unlike frozen X: resolve this source interpretation before claiming nine cells; do not silently rewrite register. Appendix2 later repeats differ from first-register rules.
